first.rationale: Onboarding simplification most directly addresses the current completion decline and may also recover activation through faster time-to-value. Promotional pricing responds to the competitive threat but carries known 30-day retention risk, which conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the primary onboarding evidence and the pricing tradeoff before committing; measure qualified activation and retained revenue, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: despite qualified-revenue lift, verified retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. Evaluate onboarding on completion, qualified activation, retention, and retained revenue.
